config.design: Capture actual normalized MLP12 inputs and raw pre-normalization residuals on locked H966 panel. Let x=c0+a*ca+n*cn+a*n*ci after RMS normalization. Define B(u,v)=Down((Left u)*(Right v)). Exact output interaction is inherited=B(c0,ci)+B(ci,c0), local=B(ca,cn)+B(cn,ca). Bias contributes only constant.
config.interventions: For each native state remove a*n times inherited interaction, local interaction, or both from its MLP12 output. Identity control. This algebraic output intervention may be off-manifold; it is not an input intervention or proof of necessity under natural edits.
config.normalization: Inherited refers to interaction already in normalized input. Raw input factorial energy is also reported, but normalization itself can generate interaction. No claim of unique causal attribution to earlier layers before normalization.
config.metrics: Full output reconstruction including Down_bias, interaction reconstruction, native-reference KL and margins after component removal. Signed vector projection shares need not be positive or bounded by one.
config.scope: No fitting; retain all H966 cohorts, distinguish native-gate failures. No held-out training tasks or original reserved test. Four familiar quartets are the only native-gated cohort.
